# Agent events API

Read recorded agent events.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_run_event` | [List agent run events](#op-get-v1-agent-run-event) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_run_event/{id}` | [Get agent run event](#op-get-v1-agent-run-event-id) |

## List agent run events {#op-get-v1-agent-run-event}

`GET /v1/agent_run_event`

Returns a paginated list of AgentRunEvent

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_run_event" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of AgentRunEvent

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].agent_plan_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_plan_step_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_run_event_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_run_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_session_id` | string |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].event_type` | string |  |
| `data[].message` | object |  |
| `data[].payload` | object |  |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

    "total": 1

## Get agent run event {#op-get-v1-agent-run-event-id}

`GET /v1/agent_run_event/{id}`

Returns a single AgentRunEvent

Set `agent_run_event_id` using IDs from your own API responses.

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | Resource identifier from your team's API results. |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_run_event/${ADIOS_AGENT_RUN_EVENT_ID}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

AgentRunEvent

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_plan_id` | string |  |
| `agent_plan_step_id` | string |  |
| `agent_run_event_id` | string |  |
| `agent_run_id` | string |  |
| `agent_session_id` | string |  |
| `created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `event_type` | string |  |
| `message` | object |  |
| `payload` | object |  |
| `team_id` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
